subject: Migrate util.c unit tests to new test framework (#448)
reason: The change is a pure test-infrastructure migration: it moves util.c's SERVER_TEST-only unit tests (string2ll, string2l, ll2string, ld2string, fixedpoint_d2string, reclaimFilePageCache) into the new unit test framework (src/unit/test_util.c, test_files.h) and deletes the old #ifdef SERVER_TEST block and utilTest registration. No production code path in util.c, server.c, or util.h is modified — all removed code was compiled only under SERVER_TEST, so a running valkey-server's behavior is identical before and after. There is nothing a fuzzer scenario against real servers could reach.
